sentence: It was the manager who made the final decision about the project
hint: Cleft sentence: It was + focus + who/that + clause
explanation: Oración hendida (cleft sentence) para dar énfasis: 'It was the manager who' pone el foco en el agente.

sentence: Were it not for the intervention of the committee, the proposal would have failed
hint: Formal conditional inversion: Were it not for...
explanation: Condicional invertida formal: 'Were it not for' = 'If it were not for'.

sentence: What concerns me most is the lack of transparency in the process
explanation: Pseudo-hendida (pseudo-cleft) para dar énfasis: 'What concerns me most is...' pone el foco en la preocupación.

sentence: Had the government acted sooner, the crisis could have been averted
explanation: Condicional invertida formal: 'Had they acted' = 'If they had acted'.

sentence: Under no circumstances should the data be shared without authorization
explanation: Anteponer un elemento negativo provoca inversión: 'should the data be shared'.

sentence: It is imperative that the findings be replicated before publication
explanation: Subjuntivo: 'be replicated' (no 'are replicated') después de 'it is imperative that'.

sentence: So profound was the impact that the entire industry was transformed
explanation: 'So + adjetivo' provoca inversión: 'So profound was the impact'.

sentence: What the research ultimately revealed was a fundamental flaw in the theory
explanation: Pseudo-hendida: 'What the research revealed was...' para dar énfasis.

sentence: Should you require any further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us
explanation: Condicional invertida formal: 'Should you require' = 'If you should require'.

sentence: It was not until the twentieth century that women gained the right to vote
explanation: Hendida con 'not until': 'It was not until...that' para dar énfasis temporal.

sentence: Such was the complexity of the problem that no single solution could be found
explanation: 'Such + be' provoca inversión: 'Such was the complexity'.

sentence: Were the proposal to be accepted, it would fundamentally change the organization
explanation: Condicional invertida formal: 'Were X to be' = 'If X were to be'.

sentence: What distinguishes this approach from others is its emphasis on collaboration
explanation: Pseudo-hendida: 'What distinguishes...is' para poner énfasis en la diferencia clave.

sentence: Not only was the experiment successful, but it also opened new avenues of research
explanation: 'Not only' provoca inversión: 'was the experiment successful'.

sentence: It is the quality of the argument, not its length, that determines its persuasiveness
explanation: Hendida con contraste: 'It is X, not Y, that...' para un contraste enfático.

sentence: Had it not been for her determination, the project would never have succeeded
explanation: Condicional invertida formal: 'Had it not been for' = 'If it had not been for'.

sentence: Rarely has a single discovery had such a profound effect on society
explanation: 'Rarely' provoca inversión: 'has a single discovery had'.

sentence: What remains to be seen is whether the policy will achieve its intended goals
explanation: Pseudo-hendida: 'What remains to be seen is whether...' para crear suspenso.

sentence: Only through sustained collaborative effort can meaningful change be achieved
explanation: 'Only through' provoca inversión: 'can meaningful change be achieved'. 'Sustained collaborative effort' es un sintagma nominal con adjetivos apilados.

sentence: It was precisely this lack of foresight that led to the eventual collapse
explanation: Hendida con intensificador: 'It was precisely X that...' para un énfasis fuerte.

sentence: So rapidly did the situation deteriorate that emergency measures were required
explanation: 'So + adverbio' provoca inversión: 'did the situation deteriorate'.

sentence: Were one to examine the evidence more closely, a different conclusion might emerge
explanation: Condicional invertida formal con el 'one' impersonal: 'Were one to examine'.

sentence: What the author fails to acknowledge is the role of cultural context
explanation: Pseudo-hendida para la crítica académica: 'What X fails to acknowledge is...'.

sentence: At no time during the negotiations was any compromise offered by either side
explanation: 'At no time' provoca inversión: 'was any compromise offered'.

sentence: It is only by questioning our assumptions that we can arrive at the truth
explanation: Hendida con 'only by': 'It is only by X that...' para poner énfasis en el método.

sentence: So far removed from reality was the proposal that no one took it seriously
hint: So + participle phrase + was + subject + that
explanation: 'So + frase participial' antepuesta provoca inversión: 'So far removed... was the proposal'.

sentence: Not since the last recession has consumer confidence fallen so sharply
hint: Not since + time reference + auxiliary + subject + verb
explanation: 'Not since' antepuesto provoca inversión: 'has consumer confidence fallen'.

sentence: Were the truth ever to come out the consequences would be catastrophic
hint: Were + subject + ever + to + infinitive (formal hypothetical)
explanation: 'Were + sujeto + to + infinitivo' es una condicional hipotética muy formal, equivalente a 'if the truth were ever to come out'.

sentence: What the committee failed to grasp was the sheer scale of the undertaking
explanation: Hendida con 'what': pone énfasis en la información nueva colocándola tras 'was'.

sentence: Such was the outcry that the policy was withdrawn within days
explanation: 'Such' antepuesto con inversión enfatiza el grado o intensidad: 'Such was the outcry that...'.
